what: One photo is split into 5×4 tiles. After 5 seconds each tile flips half a turn on the Y axis (.8s), one after another .1s apart, to show a back photo. After resting 5 seconds, the tiles fold 90° (.34s) one after another .04s apart, and at that moment the next scene’s tiles unfold from −90°. Only a hovered tile flips, then returns after .125s

options.cols: Number of cell columns, default 5 (3 recommended on phones)
options.wait: Seconds from scene standing to flip, default 5
options.hold: Time until next scene after all flipped (s), default 5
options.flip: Duration to flip one cell (sec), default .8
options.turn: Fold and unfold length when switching scenes (seconds), default .34
options.step: Delay between frames when the scene changes (s), default .04
options.back: Seconds held flipped after an Interaction, default .125
options.[data-fx-part=scene]: Scene (child) · contains [data-fx-part=front] front image·[data-fx-part=back] Back image
options.fx:go: On the element, CustomEvent('fx:go', { detail: { index } }) — if sent, it jumps to that scene · after the jump, fx:scene event

use: …
note: The image is cloned whole in each cell and shifted to its own position — video and heavy images multiply by the cell count, so use it for still photos

from.where: index.html .ih-mv (three Hero scenes, inside the site the same values on top of a Splide scene container)
